notes: Code, documents, and emails now open in separate purpose-built Workspace environments
Document pages support correct RTL and LTR direction, editing, preview, copy, and save
Email drafts open as realistic compositions with recipient, subject, body, and mail-app actions
Streaming scroll no longer stutters when returning to the latest response
A floating latest-response control shows an arrow or live typing dots
Response actions remain disabled during generation and show the final response time
Article and long-form document detection is expanded
